description.value: A Subway franchise on Summit Drive in Kamloops serving made-to-order sandwiches, wraps, and salads with fresh-baked bread and fresh-cut vegetables. The location supports in-restaurant dining, pickup, delivery, and curbside pickup, and also offers breakfast. Like all Subway locations, it is independently owned and operated.
